Question 4
?

The length of a curve y=f(x) is given by ∫−π/4π/41+1(1+x2)2dx. Which of the following could be an equation for this curve?

a
y=arcsin⁡x+2
b
y=arctan⁡x−π
c
y=2x1+x2
d
y=ln⁡(1+x2)
e
y=11+x2
